source_caption_text:
This was peak Young Thug versatility 😮‍💨🔥

I’ll never forget hearing Young Thug on Post Malone’s “Goodbyes” for the first time. The 2019 hit already had a dark, emotional atmosphere built around moody guitar melodies, heavy trap percussion, and Post Malone’s gritty vocals, but Thug’s entrance completely shifted the energy.

Thugga brought his unmistakable melodic style to the record, switching cadences and stretching his vocals across the beat in a way that felt completely unpredictable. His high-pitched delivery and emotional intensity gave the verse a chaotic energy that somehow fit perfectly with the song’s darker mood.

“Goodbyes” went on to become a massive hit, debuting and peaking at No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100. But for a lot of fans, that first moment when Young Thug comes in is still what makes the song unforgettable. It’s one of those features where you hear it once and immediately understand why Thug’s delivery was so different.
